title: 第7章 老子就是王法
slug: 官榜全本免费-官榜最新章节列表
content_zh:
在这古玩街,只要能开的起商铺的身家都不低不说,最关键还都有背景。没后台的人,想要在这古玩街站稳脚跟那是想都别想的事。
祥瑞店内站着一个身穿白色短袖衬衫,瞧上去孔武有力的男子,他有着一张很为清秀的脸蛋,略微长长的头发分出几缕遮掩着眼睛,眼珠转动间给人种很为灵气的感觉。
即便站在那里不动,男子无形中释放出来的那股气息,都让人感到是那种出身贵族世家才能培养出来的。
而就是这个男子,现在手中把玩着一对玺印。这对玺印颜色很为纯正,洁白如同羊脂白玉,质感瞧上去很为明媚细腻。雕工也很为精美传神,辟邪瑞兽印纽,让人瞧着便感到一股扑面而来的古朴气息。
“你说这是真的那就是真的,我怎么知道真假,万一是假的,我回来找你你不认账怎么办?”男子很为平静道。
祥瑞店的这位店主是一个光头,满脸笑容,圆嘟嘟的脸怎么瞧怎么像是奸臣。听到男子的话,光头扬眉道:“这位老板,咱们祥瑞要是不想要,还给我放这儿。你要是不想买,会有人争抢着买的。我还就不信,这么好的东西没人想要。”
哼,在这里和你光头爷爷耍嘴皮子,你也不打听打听,我祥瑞只要能将东西卖出去,哪怕是假的,你再想着退货,谁还认账?
李乐天把玩着这对玺印,一时间倒是有些犹豫,他根本不懂古董,来这里也是为了碰碰运气。真要是买到假货,钱还是次要,关键是面子。丢了面子,李乐天再想要找回来,那可就困难了。
在李乐天的迟疑中,光头又狠狠的加了把火,“这位老板,你要是买不起的话,就趁早离开!不然的话你就看看小店别的东西,有便宜的,相信会适合你。”
赤裸裸的相激!
果然听到光头的话,李乐天眉头顿时一扬,大声道:“谁说你爷爷买不起,不就是四万块钱吗?你爷爷还不搞价了,就是它们了,给我包起来!”
“得嘞!”光头兴奋着就要包起来,只要李乐天将钱付了,走出祥瑞的大门,那就没他什么事了。
实际上光头在古玩这行当也玩了几年,眼力劲也是有的。别的不敢说,就是眼前这对玺印,他知道都是假的。因为这是他花了六百块钱买回来的,六百块的东西能是真的?要是一下子能卖出去四万,那就赚大发了。
“等下!”
就在这时苏沐的声音悄然响起,说实话他倒真的不是正义感泛滥,非要出这个头。实在是因为直觉告诉他,眼前这个男子不简单。如果能帮到他的话,或许对自己将来有所帮助。反正今天还剩下一次鉴别的机会,扔掉也是白扔,倒不如结个善缘。
“小子,你想干什么?”光头猛地转身,死死盯向苏沐,那眼神分明是在恐吓,警告苏沐别乱说话。
“兄弟,难不成你也想要这两块玺印?可惜你来晚了,这两件归我了。”李乐天扬起嘴角笑着道。
“我倒是想要,但是太贵了,我可买不起。不过对这些个古董我还算有些研究,要不我瞧瞧?”苏沐笑道。
李乐天原本想着就这样拒绝,可是看到苏沐的笑容,不自觉的便放弃这个念头。让他瞧瞧又不碍事,再说了四万块啊。真要是买到假货,自己可就是白扔了这笔钱。说到底,自己也没有多少钱。四万块仍水坑里都能听个响声,扔到这儿算什么。
“那兄弟你就给我掌掌眼。”李乐天笑道。

光头瞧着苏沐走上前,冷光从眼底一闪而过,将两块玺印放到苏沐手中,皮笑肉不笑道:“兄弟,混哪的?”
“我能混哪,就是来这里瞎转悠转悠而已。”苏沐笑道。
“你可捧好瞧仔细了,这可是真品。来自将军洞的上等白芙蓉石做成的玺印,别给摔坏了。”光头的笑容中透露出一股威胁。
“放心吧,我会小心的。”苏沐接过玺印,有模有样的开始打量起来。第一块拿起,官榜没有动静,略微摇摇头放下。
在光头和李乐天的注视下,苏沐很为自然的拿起第二块,瞬间官榜便倏的出现,几行字让他心里总算有谱。

content_en:
In this antique street, as long as you can open a shop, your net worth will be high. The most important thing is that you have a background. It is impossible for people without a background to gain a foothold in this antique street.
Standing in the Xiangrui store was a man wearing a white short-sleeved shirt who looked powerful. He had a very delicate face, and his slightly long hair was separated into a few strands to cover his eyes. The movement of his eyes gave people a very spiritual feeling.
Even if he stood there motionless, the aura that the man invisibly released made people feel that it was the kind of aura that could only be cultivated by someone born in a noble family.
And it was this man who was playing with a pair of seals in his hands. The color of this pair of seals is very pure, as white as mutton-fat white jade, and the texture looks very bright and delicate. The carvings are also very exquisite and lifelike, and the seals used to ward off evil spirits and auspicious animals make people feel a sense of simplicity when they look at them.
"If you say it's true, then it's true. How do I know if it's true? What if it's false and I come back to you and you don't admit it?" the man said very calmly.
The owner of the Xiangrui store has a bald head, a smile on his face, and his chubby face looks like a traitor. Hearing the man's words, the bald man raised his eyebrows and said, "Boss, if our Xiangrui don't want it, just leave it here. If you don't want to buy it, there will be people vying to buy it. I still don't believe it, no one wants such a good thing."
Humph, I'm here to talk nonsense with your bald grandfather, and you won't ask any questions. As long as I, Xiangrui, can sell something, even if it's fake, if you think about returning it, who will accept it?
Li Letian played with the pair of seals and hesitated for a moment. He didn't understand antiques at all and came here to try his luck. If you really buy a fake, money is secondary, the key is face. After losing face, it would be difficult for Li Letian to get it back.
During Li Letian's hesitation, the bald man added more fuel to the fire, "Boss, if you can't afford it, leave as soon as possible! Otherwise, look at other items in the store. There are cheap ones, I believe they will be suitable for you."
Naked mutual excitement!
Sure enough, when he heard the bald man's words, Li Letian raised his eyebrows and said loudly: "Who said your grandpa can't afford it? Isn't it just 40,000 yuan? Your grandpa won't set the price yet, it's just them, wrap it up for me!"
"Okay!" The bald man was about to wrap it up excitedly. As long as Li Letian paid the money and walked out of Xiangrui's door, nothing would happen to him.
In fact, Baldhead has been in the antique business for several years, and he also has a sharp eye. He didn't dare to say anything else, but he knew that the pair of seals in front of him were all fake. Because he bought it for 600 yuan. Can something worth 600 yuan be real? If he could sell it for 40,000 yuan at once, he would make a lot of money.
"Wait a minute!"
At this moment, Su Mu's voice sounded quietly. To be honest, he really didn't have a sense of justice and insisted on doing this. It was because his intuition told him that the man in front of him was not simple. If I can help him, it may help me in the future. Anyway, there is still one opportunity left for identification today, and throwing it away will be in vain. It is better to form a good relationship.
"Boy, what do you want to do?" The bald head turned around suddenly and stared at Su Mu. His eyes were clearly threatening, warning Su Mu not to talk nonsense.
"Brother, is it possible that you also want these two seals? It's a pity that you are late, these two pieces belong to me." Li Letian raised the corner of his mouth and said with a smile.
"I would like it, but it's too expensive and I can't afford it. But I have done some research on these antiques, how about I take a look?" Su Mu said with a smile.
Li Letian originally thought about rejecting it like this, but when he saw Su Mu's smile, he unconsciously gave up the idea. Let him take a look and it won't be a problem. Besides, it cost 40,000 yuan. If you really buy a fake, you will just throw away the money in vain. After all, I don’t have much money. Forty thousand yuan can still make a sound in the puddle. Throw it inNothing here.
"Then brother, just give me your eyes." Li Letian smiled.
The bald man watched Su Mu step forward. A cold light flashed through his eyes. He put the two seals in Su Mu's hands and said with a smile: "Brother, where are you doing?"
"What can I do? I just come here to wander around." Su Mu said with a smile.
"You should hold it carefully and take a closer look. This is the real thing. The seal is made of the finest white hibiscus stone from Jiangjun Cave. Don't break it." There was a threat in the bald head's smile.
"Don't worry, I'll be careful." Su Mu took the seal and began to look at it in a decent manner. I picked up the first piece, but there was no movement on the official list. I shook my head slightly and put it down.
Under the gaze of the bald man and Li Letian, Su Mu naturally picked up the second piece. In an instant, the official list appeared. A few lines of words made him finally feel at ease.
